title: 49ers WR De'Zhaun Stribling's Achilles is intact, to undergo MRI on ankle

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: 49ers WR De'Zhaun Stribling's Achilles is intact, to undergo MRI on ankle
sources.description: The way 49ers wide receiver De'Zhaun Stribling suddenly ended his route and started limping on one leg had everyone thinking the worst.
